environment.description: ECS Fargate service in AWS account 998877665544 within OU 'ou-prod-workloads'. Task role arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/graphql-service-task-role has the same AdministratorAccess policy attached BUT is subject to permission boundary arn:aws:iam::998877665544:policy/PB-DenyEscalation-v3 which contains an explicit Deny on iam:AttachRolePolicy, iam:PutRolePolicy, iam:CreatePolicy, iam:PassRole, s3:DeleteObject, and s3:PutBucketPolicy with a StringNotEquals condition on aws:PrincipalTag/service-class != 'platform-admin'. Additionally, the OU has SCP sid 'DenyDataExfil' that denies s3:GetObject when aws:ResourceAccount does not match the organization accounts list, and a separate SCP sid 'RestrictRDSNetworking' that denies rds-data:ExecuteStatement unless the VPC endpoint source is from the approved CIDR. The RDS instance uses pg_hba.conf restricting connections to the task ENI security group only, and the database role used by the application has GRANT SELECT on users, documents only (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/EXECUTE on pg_catalog). Note: the GraphQL SQL injection in searchUsers is still reachable but the DB role cannot perform writes or access system catalogs, and the IAM permission boundary blocks the privilege escalation via attachRolePolicy in updateUserRole mutation.

scp_policies.condition: unless VPC endpoint from approved CIDR

config.db_role_grants: GRANT SELECT ON users, documents TO app_readonly
config.db_role_revokes: REVOKE ALL ON pg_catalog FROM app_readonly; REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES FROM app_readonly
config.network: egress restricted to VPC endpoints only
